data.title: Exact followup: static authority expression binding 6184313b
data.description: Independent exact followup review of remediation commit 6184313bc3a6d07bbb988db1a8353bcd88ac32a3 / tree 0cf8b277c0fe6a6454de009a299c36113d2616d6, parent 53845bd655642c865037fed1459d3023e0622120. Verify cr-2l039r thread th-3hmdsf: reject same-typed allocation, CPU, counter, timestamp, nonce, tuple-order, seed-call/argument, A/C/D smoke/full accounting, and domain_events+17 mutations. Confirm only prepare_overlays.py changed and runtime/schema/timed paths are identical. Static-only; no compiler, build, timing, or evidence.

data.body: HIGH: The remediation binds exact call/body tuples but does not bind the corresponding same-typed function signatures, so th-3hmdsf remains bypassable through parameter-order swaps. Independent in-memory full-static-self-test probes made each of these compile-valid changes: Control::ready_and_wait_start allocation_calls_start/allocated_bytes_start swapped; process_user_cpu_start_ns/process_system_cpu_start_ns swapped; ready_monotonic_ns/counter_start_monotonic_ns swapped; and borrowed assert_reopen_seed_accounting domain_events/fresh_streams swapped. Every mutation left prepare_overlays.static_self_test returning status ok. The control swaps relabel the caller values despite the now-exact call and format tuples; the borrowed swap makes C compare its log high-water against fresh_streams, while A/D addition happens to mask the same swap. Bind the exact signatures, including parameter order and types, for shared control ready/measured methods and current/borrowed seed accounting functions, then add hostile signature-order cases to the full static test. Current 6184313 runtime sources remain identical to the approved parent, but the claimed static authority remediation is incomplete.

data.reason: HIGH th-3hmdsf remediation incomplete: compile-valid same-typed function-signature order swaps remain accepted by the full static self-test.
